abstract: A complete, globally unique three-phase solution for timing three independent seed cohorts against one shared exponentially timed effective rainfall event with exponential viability loss.
integrity: Exact algebraic global-optimality proof with executable numerical and symbolic spot checks; novelty qualified by documented access and literature risks.
scientific_limitations: Single effective first rain with exponential rate equal to seed-viability decay rate
Three identical independent cohorts conditional on the rain, with fixed success probability p
Deterministic, nonadaptive sowing dates and no terminal season or cost
No field calibration; does not assert novelty against all possible older scheduling literature
title: Three sharp sowing-date regimes before one random rainfall opportunity
